<thought>We need to find the retrosynthetic template that corresponds to the DIBAL-H reduction of an ester to an aldehyde (breaking a C–O single bond and forming an aliphatic hydroxyl). The target molecule (the one being retrosynthesized) appears to be the first SMILES in the precursor pairs returned earlier:
C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO
We will search the template catalog for templates that break an ester and form an aldehyde.</thought>
